zh.name: 配色到实际物料灵感板
zh.summary: 把一组命名配色、色签和实际物料或空间照片放在一起，展示如何落地。
zh.useWhen: 展示色彩应用，不声称全部来自同一照片；与照片取色区分。
zh.instructions: 配色值、应用领域、对应材质或场景图
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Palette Application Board
en.summary: Create an Instagram showcase carousel using the palette application board structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the palette application board format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
